# sift Agent Context

> TD-first map for agents. Start from tech design and capability intent before implementation files.

## Tech Design

- [Tech Design](tech-design): implementation source of truth.
- Validate: `aw td check projects/sift/tech-design`.

## Capability Map

- [README](README.md): capability source of truth and product contract.

## Agent Workflow

- Capability next action: `aw capability next --project sift`.
- Readiness: `aw health --project sift`.
- Blockers: `aw health --project sift blockers`.

## Commands

- Build debug: `./build.sh debug`.
- Build release: `./build.sh release`.
- Install: repo root `install.sh --project=sift` dispatches to `./install.sh`.
- Test: `cargo test -p sift --lib --bins`.

## Root Artifacts

- [llms.txt](llms.txt): generated by AW from TD-first project context.
- [build.sh](build.sh): debug/release build entrypoint.
- [install.sh](install.sh): project-local install entrypoint.
<!-- CODEGEN-END -->
<!-- HANDWRITE-BEGIN gap="sift-live-backup-agent-context" tracker="2367" reason="Keep the runtime backup safety boundary explicit until the semantic context generator projects command-level operations." -->

## Backup Safety Boundary

- Scheduled and online backups use `sift backup --url <service> --dest gs://...`
  and the protected `GET /admin/backup` endpoint. Supply an admin token with
  `--token` or `SIFT_BACKUP_TOKEN` when auth is required.
- `sift backup --data-dir <path>` is legacy offline-only operation for a stopped
  journal. Never open the live service PVC from a second process.
- Restore remains `sift restore --data-dir <stopped-path> --source <uri>`.

<!-- HANDWRITE-END -->
